biotools.summary: SCARD (Split-read, Chimeric read-pAirs, and Read-depth Difference) is a software tool for detecting and characterizing rare genomic structural variants using genome sequencing data. It accurately identifies structural variants and contributes to understanding their role in recessive conditions.
